title: Citation-Level Unfaithfulness of Small Language Models on Vietnamese Banking Regulation: A Provenance-Guarded RAG Benchmark
description:
RegRAG-VN is a QA-driven benchmark and evaluation framework for Vietnamese banking and payment regulation, accompanying the IEEE-RIVF 2026 paper of the same title. It holds 88 questions (64 answerable over State Bank of Vietnam circulars, decrees and laws, each with a gold passage, 63 repaired verbatim with article-level Điều gold plus one summary annex item; and 24 unanswerable probes whose gold label requires explicit refusal) alongside a two-tier corpus whose coverage invariant requires every retained verbatim gold passage to match an ingested chunk.

The release contains the ingestion and evaluation code, the two-tier corpus, the raw ingested sources (redistributed as downloaded from official government sources; original terms apply), the full 792-row generation campaign log (3 models x 3 retrieval modes x 88 questions, one RTX 3090, 4-bit quantisation, greedy decoding), the retrieval-recall logs for the sparse (BM25 + pyvi) and dense (BGE-M3) arms, the computed table inputs and the paper PDF. Every record carries its corpus tier, retriever backend and quantisation tag; aggregation refuses rows with unset or degraded provenance. The campaign ran on the Tier-1 fixture, disclosed as an upper-bound conditioning in the paper; retrieval quality is measured on the full Tier-2 corpus.
